Overview / Features / Situational Awareness
Common operating picture

See the same incident from every angle.

A map alone cannot explain the operation. ArcHorizon brings locations, team and task status, narrative, weather, hazards, and emerging information into one picture for command and planning.

Three connected lenses

Location, status, and meaning.

Each view answers a different question. Together they show what happened and what should happen next.

01 / WHERE

Map

Assignments, resources, clues, hazards, access, and planning areas in geographic context.

02 / WHO & WHAT

Boards

Which teams are available, what tasks are active, and where work is waiting.

03 / WHY IT MATTERS

Reports

Narrative, intelligence, safety, and weather updates that explain a change in the picture.

A connected update

Follow information into a decision.

For example, a field hazard report can change a map feature, appear in command review, and alter the next assignment.

FIELDTeam reports a hazard

Location and description arrive with the assignment record.

MAPHazard becomes visible

Operations can see it beside affected work and access routes.

COMMANDPlan is adjusted

The next briefing or task can include a control or alternate route.

The shared picture

One update appears where it matters.
